messages.subject: INLA on Ubuntu
parts:
Hi all,

Is there a special way to install INLA on ubuntu Linux? It seems that there is something not quite right with the standard installation. Even trying to create the most basic models fail i.e

> library(INLA)
> m = 50
> points = matrix(runif(m*2), m, 2)
> mesh = inla.mesh.2d(loc=points,cutoff=0.05,offset=c(0.1, 0.4),max.edge=c(0.05, 0.5) )
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
Error in fmesher.read(prefix, "manifold") :
  File '/tmp/Rtmpw0m7qq/fmesher76381f0554d5.manifold' does not exist.

or 

 n=12
> Ntrials = sample(c(80:100), size=n, replace=TRUE)
> eta = rnorm(n,0,0.5)
> prob = exp(eta)/(1 + exp(eta))
> y = rbinom(n, size=Ntrials, prob = prob)
> data=data.frame(y=y,z=1:n)
> formula=y~f(z,model="iid",
+ hyper=list(theta=list(prior="loggamma",param=c(1,0.01))))
> result=inla(formula,data=data,family="binomial",Ntrials=Ntrials)
/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla: /usr/local/lib/R/site-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/libgomp.so.1: version `GOMP_4.0' not found (required by /usr/lib/libR.so)
